about: Football > Football shorts and the Football Full kit's shorts (MODELQ8 2026-11-25, coordinator; cut from the Full Soccer Kit cards 13878 front / 10440 back, D:/3d-app/tripo/cards): Tripo model football-shorts-textured.glb (shape only), the print all over (its parts file was too patchy for clean colour edges: no parts). WIDE: every shorts design without another model's flag (old saved Football shorts and kit designs open on it); it replaces the made shorts and their old look (the black slit in the side stripe, bug 143) on those two tiles. Look from the card: royal blue all over, our crest low on the wearer's right leg and our 3DEEZI wordmark on the left where the card has its marks; the card's own logos not copied. First version (models live first).
